## Before merge

- [ ] CI is green on the current HEAD.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes have CODEOWNERS review.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, OAuth codes, or credentials are committed.
- [ ] READ-ONLY audit invariants remain intact.
- [ ] Production WRITE remains blocked unless explicitly evidenced and authorized.
- [ ] New dependencies/actions are justified and reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation and canonical project registry are updated when behavior changes.
